I-tham hen Sadatha ah lam laid e-Gemini 3.5 Flash.

help.title: MosaicView - Bâd thuriol
help.intro: MosaicView ertha achen na orthad a gohedo gonedir (gondirin golwen) ú-bui na esgeli hain o theirair. I harfuil orthal i thîr CBZ (ZIP), CBR (RAR) a PDF. I thangail nâ celeg na i chin 64 bit er-orath.
help.open_files_content:
• Nedhoro i thúr 'Edro pheth' egor toltho a dego faif erui vi i thúr
• Chír orthol: CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, PDF, randir (JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, ICO). EPUB faif ece edro anhên, dan i randirain dîn erui a-dregir (i thith ú-chenir).
• PDF prenn (auth gwend nauthol an edro): ú-belir nestado i faif, aew certheniel a-genir.
• PDF nauthol na thírad (owner password): i pennath a-nestador anhên. MosaicView anna garad er echant dúlennol o i faif vi i taur dín.
• Hirn i randirain athrenil: pan aphenner cast, i randirain naeth sui ben (raxë síwedel egor annediad) a-genir arnhên le sam oren ned i randir vethig. I archen "Dartha i athrenilath" (bâd Aduial, nedhoro i formen ar i vosaic, egor ar randir vethig) a-aphenner fennas le pob raid o randirain sui ben, as i·dhilifio i choll pob randir.
help.mosaic_content:
I mosaig gweda hain parth o aen bereth vi thiliol. Ci chem:
• Athra i parth trî thelia a degir (partha-rem ben automagol, a aphada i cuia enedh-rem maenas)
• Ethro mî parth (Ctrl+pitha or Shift+pitha)
• Adloda thilia-sad am i calbar
• Ailoda eneth i feil trî pitha ha eneth
• Thelia a degir bereth-feil (CBZ/CBR/PDF) hen Windows Explorer thennas o aen bereth egor ned hadra ha gost
• Govado i phennath thithen uireb a i-lû thiad vîr gîn (tolen thurin, echanted Ctrl+Alt+T)
• Ethro fánfap: parth uireb ned dôf i mosaig, thí hain aen bereth vi thiliol vinui, a i cudherven aen dôl gwannen sí. Pitha egor thelia am dôl i bereth-sad. Aravitima Cadwedd mír egor pitha dain i mosaig.
help.manipulation_content:
• Tolo egor trasto i randirain i·dhi ednodio
• Tolo archiv veleg vi archiv eraid i·dhi annediad
• Nedhoro i formen ar randir na naeth i·athol (misto, deleb, hb.)
• Ganad formen ar randir i egor i lû istol
• Esgalo randirain erui, drego dhin bar and-gorvâr Windows, egor as Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V
help.renumber_content:
Aníra MosaicView neled modh athnimherad i bess, gennen vi i athol athnimherad, i lû istol (rîn i lîw a chuin), i tâl e barad-archen, egor athrannen na rîn a thregad:

• Modh angerthad o bess maded (modh hen pen): i celebren cened i thand o bess pân a chened bess tadui, neled, a venid. Bessui meded athnimheren (vel. bess tadui anim 003-004, neled 005-006-007). Athan canad bess, min a methed nadath cened (vel. 010---025).

• Modh nimherad sain: pân bess cael min nadath ungerthad (001, 002, 003...), pen i thand.

• Modh diestannen: athnimherad athrannen diestannen. I eneth bess hen i athol gennir, athan vi i thregad.

Na chuiniath modh, rîn i lîw telwain a thregad athol nó rîn i tâl e barad-archen. I lû istol tira i modh enni vi i thand. I modh cílina venna yando na athrannen athnimherad vi i thregad, ar nattir enyalda.
help.flatten_content: Pe i târ gerir and-gorvaraid, breitho 'Pelthaedi i gorvaraid' na brestegi nel i rendir na i andeb er.
help.viewer_content:
Naru i tell na chad na laD chu':
• Nótharon ← →: goheno rlinn telleir
• Nótharon D: goheno pân 4 laD cham
  - Tell er: tell ú ah ú
  - Telleir edeb: tell 1 er, ab 2-3, 4-5, ath
  - Telleir edeb tadol: tell 1 er, ab 2-3, 3-4, 4-5, ath
  - Webtoon: an rendir tîr (webcomics), lath annui na 900px an gonad legib; roth megil belga tîr mi tell, ab goheno tell ne dâr/nu
• Roth megil: goheno lim (belga tîr mi tell na laD cham Webtoon)
• Ctrl+Roth egor Ctrl+Ah/Del: megil (adel 1000% i haered chent randir)
• Ctrl+0: Adnortho i megil na chad
• Ctrl+1: megil 100% (i haered pixel chent randir)
• Nedhoro ledin egor tochenno: goheno i randir echui ir dartha vell chad
• Nótharon F11: bâd rlinn
• Nedhoro pân: goheno bâd rlinn
• Nótharon Esc: Deleb i faen dregol / govano na laD chu'
• Tavor: hebeno lim i tell si dartha ir govano na laD chu' (egor pen tell erui a minui). Faen caran nuion na randir vinn i mîw. Ir echui adarthannen, i sadron suila govediad na tell hen. Delebannen lim na tell minui, egor pân nedhoro ledin na laD chu'.
help.join_pages_content:
Cíla lain bess i chuina, rîn i lîw a chuin → 'Modh bess cílina' na chuina bess sennas egor thennas. I celvad emma venna i chened o bess maded, qui pân genediar; egor PNG i modh hen pen. Cael cíla deleb egor gennad i bess hen.

I tâl e bess vinui vi i emmadraith:
• Modh athnimherad angerthad (angerthad egor mhaethen): i bess cael i tâl e minui chuina bess (i thâl, qui i bess hen deleb, egor athan nu, qui gennir), ar tortha athnimherad.
• Modh athnimherad diestannen: i bess anta vi i minui i emmadraith an eneth "Annediad_xxx".
help.split_pages_content:
Na dagro thennas telleir edeb:
• Eglerio i telleir na dhagro
• Ganad formen → 'Dagro i telleir thelegin'
• Eglerio i rhaw (orthi pedo forn)
help.crop_content:
Mi harthad, tiro sell ben i randir na meril dôl orchad:
• Tiro i sell nu lhaw
• Admerio hen nu tírad ben i remair pedo i berain
• Gano ben 'Orchal i orchad' na hertha
• I orchad heren na randir sui sír
• Tungol Échap: awartha i thammas
help.shortcuts_content:
• Ctrl+Z: Avedui i amarth erui
• Ctrl+Y: Adrevedui i amarth Avedui
• Ctrl+A: Cíla pân telleir
• Ctrl+I: Adel i cíla
• Ctrl+C: Honom i telleir cílannen
• Ctrl+X: Risto i telleir cílannen
• Ctrl+V: Pado i telleir
• Del: Deleb i telleir cílannen
• Ctrl+Roth megil: Megil (laD chu') / haered nîw (mîw) / haered randir (taur randir)
• Ctrl+0 (laD chu'): Adnortho i megil na chad
• Ctrl+1 (laD chu'): Megil 100% (i haered chent randir)
• Nedhoro ledin egor tochenno (laD chu'): Goheno i randir echui
• Ctrl+Alt+T: Racho pân nîw echui o'n mîw
• F5: Adannenno i tírad mîw
• F11: Goheno bâd rlinn (govano gin F11 egor ESC)
help.dark_mode_content: Pitha i cannas anor/ithil ned thelia calen a morn thent.

Breitho i vuid 'Nestegi' na adnestegi thennas i telleir nu:

help.save_content:
• 'Garo': garo i gohelaith mi bâr edhellen
• 'Garo hen': caro târ nui

Ano bo dâr, i garad ledig na CBZ, na târ ZIP pen o pân. Aníra i thand bo hen na 0. Cened i thaul Modh cened ZIP hen pen an rond bellas.
help.other_content:
• Misto: misto er pedo rendir erui
• Edregol: edrego i rendir na thîr edhellen (PNG, JPEG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, GIF). Pedo: i rendir CMYK autorui edregannar na RGB
• Teitho: teitho i telleir thelegin pedo nel i telleir
• Esgalad: esgelo telleir uirib
help.config_files_content:
MosaicView harna beirain parvin nan i·taur {temp_dir}, naug aden i·nírad randir henin ir echui.
Parvin hin teqannen nu bâd o i·echedi. Annad hen naug teqi im i·taur {temp_dir}, mal nedhoro i·nern nu vi: adertha am i·harfuil.

help.language_content:
MosaicView erib mi lemmir erui.
Sui bâd, i harfuil hannatha thennas i lamm o lhaw i lhaw a panna mi lamm hen pe orthol. Pe i lhaw breithar lamm ú-orthol, i harfuil pannatha mi Annui.
Nenich gohedo lhaw i lamm sui lû nu breitho i menegol dannen sui bed o thírd o vuidain, nu bed i rhegol o veir nirn-randirain. I egleriad gwerent a heren na dreviad minui i harfuil.
LEMMIR ERIB: Annui, Arad, Arabad, Armeleg, Belgiaid, Bolgareg, Chinan (rimmen), Chinan (thannol), Coread, Croateg, Daneg, Eileg, Estoneg, Fenneg, Galleg, Giriegol, Gwindig, Hindi, Hungareg, Indonesiad, Islandeg, Italiad, Iapaneg, Lettoneg, Lituaneg, Maleg, Malteg, Nederlandeg, Norvegeg, Poloneg, Portegol, Romeg, Slovaceg, Sloveneg, Suideg, Tamil, Tchegol, Thai, Tyrceg, Ucraniad, Vietnamiad.
LEMMIR ANNEDOL ERIB: klingon (rimm ghItlh latin a ghItlh pIqaD), sindarin (rimm ghItlh latin a ghItlh tengwar), quenya (rimm ghItlh latin a ghItlh tengwar).

Si revthin an úgartha tinconi Windows, ach pIqaD (lamm Klingon) ar tengwar (lemmir Edhellen: Sindarin ar Quenya) tinconi. Tinconi hen nar úgartha chutmey ar tulir o arnedir hen:
- pIqaD an (parf Klingon lamm): {url_piqad}
- tengwar an (parf Edhel, Sindarin ar Quenya an): {url_tengwar}
Pe arnedir hen ú-gwerir tanna, cenich tirtha tinconi pIqaD ar tengwar nu ganad i vuidain sui ned:

Harfuil hen nerthanen mi Edhellen. I edregolaith mi lemmir erui carannen nu IA, celwir nu Claude. Nerthanen carad daged rim lemmir, dan ú-iston pain lemmir hen. Ú-erin dâr eraid egor sui garo caul rim edregolir nedhben. Nu rimm thennas i edregolaith, eneth meria vin aegair. Anno daer, awarth nin.

help.split_ui_content:
MosaicView a allow gwelet dou archiv yn preder, tu ha tu.

Toc i vuidon Nótho na paned thui edro. Pan paned dôr han: bado edro, anno, a sartha archiv dîn. I paned cuia sinnir vi luith lasc.

Na phyrth lesta o paned na paned, raeg in hain ent. Ce parth ethrir iest, lestir pan na genediad. I phyrth savant vi sad annir vi barre caran.

Toc i vuidon Serra i paned thui na mod paned eraid edro.

I govan i·dôr in paned iest pennas raitha. Nesta i archant dessui restad i paned vi maen-then (50/50).

help.config_log_note: I ambar-vellad (PDF vin CBZ a CBR vin CBZ) chenatha ambar hena in Ú-mae martha. Ambar hin (Log_pdftocbz_.txt a Log_cbrtocbz_.txt) tegil needh apa i vosaic dhannen, an cened adh. Delthannen erui thand "Dele ambar berain" nuin. Ambar Log_scan.txt cenatha sui Chenatha bain (Chenor lostannen, pae, tulu egor Ú-mae) — anna genediad Chenor lîn.
help.adjust_images_content: I chîr hen anna le adfaeda i randirain lín needig vi MosaicView. Cael le athreidio i galas, i thregad, i vain, i lend, i annedil, cemmen effeithau (morn a gwen, sepia, dulu i galassath), athreidio i chaun cened, dilio i galassath, cemmen anwedh egor athrenna na lend galas eraid. Le annon i lû istol dîn i·dhilifel na cened i tregad na lend veleg nu chemmed. Adlan mân-lun tíra i tregad vi lû annedin ned i fennas veleg.
help.create_icon_content:
MosaicView leithia le caro i veth tîw (.ico) o any picture in i veth mosaig.
• Nauth mîn i picture → 'Caro i veth tîw'
• Tangado i mîn i cenirth (i veth tîw nauva côr)
• Cenno i nixë mauya
• Varyë: i .ico veth addë coimas mossë
• I .ico vethi automarë sarnë ilyë commë vanwi (16×16 ter 256×256)
• Tennoio i .ico veth ná mosaigossë, i tancë CBZ tancalanna ná harna, an i ICO commë ú-sarnë tancalnar. Ela i .ico veth enquerissë (Ctrl+C ar pasta Windowsë), sí antar co ohtë mosaigossë anta varyiëllo.
help.batch_convert_content:
MosaicView anna eneg carfath cantad lot, garen erui ir i mosaig ú-baen.
An bess: cilo taur, aphado, tiro i bess si i lû, tiro i methed. Er dôl leithia dregi i faif gerin dhi
an lá tego han i chorbell.
• CBR → CBZ: canta ilya CBR faif (RAR) o taur ar i thúr-taur. Cé CBR ná ZIP, 7z egor TAR, i faif
athesta mi i chír maer (.cbz, .cb7 egor .cbt) ú cantad. I faif athestannen ar i raeg cennir mi log.
• CB7 → CBZ: canta ilya CB7 faif (7-Zip) o taur ar i thúr-taur. Cé CB7 ná ZIP, RAR egor TAR, i faif
athesta mi i chír maer (.cbz, .cbr egor .cbt) ú cantad. I faif athestannen ar i raeg cennir mi log.
• CBT → CBZ: canta ilya CBT faif (TAR) o taur ar i thúr-taur. Cé CBT ná ZIP, RAR egor 7z, i faif
athesta mi i chír maer (.cbz, .cbr egor .cb7) ú cantad. I faif athestannen ar i raeg cennir mi log.
• PDF → CBZ: canta ilya PDF faif o taur ar i thúr-taur. I randir dregir ú athrenna.
• RANDIR ERUI → CBZ: caro er CBZ an pân randir-faif hirnen vi i taur ar i thúr-taur. I randir ú-vaer,
orthel, and-thilith (TIFF) egor cuinen (GIF) ú-orthanner ar cennir mi log.
• TOLTHO NOTHRANNATH: sada dad Nothrannath (eneth, lú, tegil…) o ComicVine an pân faif maer
(CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, PDF) o taur ar i thúr-taur. Idh eria erui erui an pân faif.
• CARO THAMB: sarna pân faif maer o taur ar i thúr-taur vi er vinya Thamb MosaicView (*.mvdb).
Tiro i vund Thamb an rimm henion.
• ATHRENNA CENED CBZ NA I MODH HEN PEN: sarna ilya CBZ, CBR, CB7 ar CBT faif o taur ar i thúr-taur.
I chír anwa o pân faif hirnen ú i chír dín: faif eneth dhraug (v. .cbr ed i ná ZIP anwa) athesta mi
i chír maer nó carad. Er CBZ anwui athrenna cennir, ar erui cé ú venna i modh hen pen. I methed
glor: pân faif sarnen, athrenna cennir, venna i modh hen pen, ar ú-cennir (an ú CBZ).
help.icon_toolbar_content: I lûr eiconau anna athrad vain na naeth veleg i chîr. Cael le athreidio i eiconau sui annedin, drego dhi needig vi i lûr. Mi eglerio pân eiconau na thíred egor dolen, nedhoro i formen rundil i·chranthedig ned tâl i lûr: a-genir fennas i·govannad, i·le cael drego eiconau nu i lûr weithredol a i chronfa. Na i vothon « + » ah « − » athreidio meir i eiconau. I·chovannad cadwyr auto.
help.nfo_editor_content:
NFO-parf i parf teitho (.nfo enethren) i gabed tirhad an i archiv: hammad, cannas, nothas…

Carpho NFO-parf, anno i dêr hain vi i orthad, vi i lêst parf, egor vi i lêst comhad (pent forven vi i mosaig). I amber erib ach nag i mosaig ú-lanw. Anno eneth a hammad: i barf carpho sui vi i mosaig, bain amman gûr egor teitho erin-lend.

Gresto NFO-parf iest, nesta i archant vi i mosaig. I thûl aphenner pre-anno eneth a hammad iest, ammen gresto. Vi ammen, i trevad nottir vi i lêst heb-no.
help.metadata_content:
MosaicView leithia sada Nothrannath in lú lín (eneth, Lú, nau, tegil…) o daur ComicVine, er iant
govaded i chair.

Mód erui: egeria i lû, si iuitho i dôl o i thúr egor i Nothrannath menu. Aphad tad: cilo athan i Lú,
si i nau maer. Nothrannath sarna ComicInfo.xml nu i faif.

Mód an pân: lanta er egor rimm taur mi i mosaig ar cilo "Toltho Nothrannath an pân", egor iuitho
i dôl dín o i thúr egor i Nothrannath menu. Idh eria erui erui an pân faif hirnen (CBZ, CBR, CB7,
CBT, PDF). Faif ú-CBZ athestar mi CBZ abed Nothrannath sarnen.

Têw API: boe têw API ComicVine ú-meir. I channas tiruva le. Hirnen erin comicvine.gamespot.com
abed er rant echannen. I têw ú-garen bo pân eglain: chrypthannen nu Windows DPAPI ar únestathog
hen erin i rant Windows lín.

Naded API: naded hen thandar nu ComicVine ar ú-belir dregi.
• 200 pedid an·randir an·luin. Cé i naded hen dreier, i cened haeda tenn i luin gwannen.
• 100 methed an·pedid, i naid boe rannen mi rimm pedid an lú i·garar rimm nau.
• 1 pedid an·lû annen nu i daur. An estel, MosaicView dreia 2 lû iban pân pedid, an pedid lend
belir carë naded morn.

Chír had ComicVine: had ComicVine ece caro tad chír, sui i coron dín. MosaicView ista i tad chír.
• Chír sí: comicvine.gamespot.com/.../4000-XXXXX an nau, comicvine.gamespot.com/.../4050-XXXXX an lû.
• Chír iaur: comicvine.com/.../37-XXXXX an nau (i nót abed i thang ná i sam ennas; erui i dom ar
i thelchor goenner).

I dôl hen certha i vund {scraper} am men.
help.library_content:
I Thamb leithia le catalogu ar hirë i lû teleryn lín erui iuitho i Nothrannath garen mi pân faif lín
(eneth, Lú, tegil, tirhor…) ar govaded dhi mi er Thamb faif erui (*.mvdb).

An caro Thamb, iuitho i thúr Thamb → Massa nóna, egor lanta er egor rimm taur mi i mosaig ar
cilo "Caro Thamb o taur(in)". MosaicView si sarna i taur lín ar sarna erui pân faif maer hirnen.

Cé i Thamb eria, ece cilo i lû lín athan Lú, tegil, coron, tirhor, an. hen, iban rimm naded lend
aphaded. Er tad-honom eria i faif mi MosaicView. I methed ece sarnad athan XLSX (Excel).
help.zip_compression_content:
MosaicView annon lelio cened i modh cened ZIP venna pân lû CBZ thregad, gennen vi i tâl e barad-archen, i athol Cened, egor i lû istol (rîn i lîw telwain a chuin).

I modh hen pen 0 (ú gened): i emyn neled cenir vi i raul gennir (JPEG, PNG, WebP...), sin cened i barad ZIP athan diheno ú anna sant, dan athrenna i thregad a i lend. Modh hen pole venna, dan ú aníra, athan na lû.

I tâl e barad-archen tira i nanwen cened lestassen i lend lestassë: "0" eb i bess hen ú cened, "1" eb cened (ZIP barad ú lavo ist i naned modh), egor "--" eb i bess hen ú CBZ. Rîn telwain na i tâl anta venna i bess (egor venna na CBZ) na i modh hen pen, edra mára. Rîn a chuiniath i modh hen pen.
help.wilhelm_scream_content:
Rain uin dín agor a raug tortha i yell Wilhelm, thand lend enni pilthin i lend a dram edwen o'r 1950 anann. Ae ú-genich i sui, i randir Wikipedia (i Saesneg) pêd sad: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wilhelm_scream
I lend genediad i MosaicView úan i randir hen a bêd i-chirith an WAV, dan i chair genediad cened.
help.config_single_instance_note: MosaicView pen echui 'wain edwen. Ir echedi ambar (be aphada' o Explorer, thaid) i ammar rast echui, u aphad edwen ú-adwenna: ambar echui vain nan rast rast, ar rast na tira hamma. Aden hen echui, MosaicView harn nan Golover Windows aden pân echui (tir nu).
help.config_registry_note: Aden aphada rast "Echo bo" o Windows Explorer, MosaicView tecil harn nothrannath nan Golover Windows na echui — parf redhui i pêd Windows man ammar rast a MosaicView ar man rueil ambar aphada. Tecil hen ú-vedui nan gerthad annen. Tecil vain nan haran Golover annen aden i cont adan, pen nan haran nell, ar ú-aphel man harn ambar-thand: tirad MosaicView mal rast rael aden rueil ambar rast ratha gerthad ir naug pêd, be rast "Echo bo" o Windows sui. Ir dhelib MosaicView nan taur lín, harn hen echui gwath ar pen tirith.
help.config_dir_content:
MosaicView tecil parf henna .mosaicview_config.json. Parf hen harya wîv nan i·chaes (aphada, thind, phith, i·nírad i·na echedi orchad…), i·lû i·pheirith â i·pharfath pantannen aphada, i·gerthadin lín, ar i·têw API ComicVine lín (parch). Caeda vi i·taur {config_dir} ar tira caita rast am rast: â-veren beirain, ú-echui vain, mal MosaicView mal Windows.
Annad hen naug teqi im i·taur {config_dir}, mal nedhoro i·nern nu. Adertha am i·chaes chu i·nírad hîn aden i·harfuil vain a MosaicView echui.
help.scan_content:
• Podo an chîn "Ceno" (i thand genoer, i lend Ambar, egor podo dhelig vo i vosaic) an athrado i host Chenatha. MosaicView cenatha i Chenor lîn erui (thand WIA, thand cened Windows): mede i genor, i ninnas (DPI), i chalich (chalich / lith-mith / morn a nimp), a podo "Ceno". I genor tolel, vaded, a i thand dînen anann Windows an tolthad vo i lest.
• I genor cheniannen thent, i ninnas, a i chalich haeðent tirin, a podin ennas nedh vosaic pathad.
• I chenatha nedh vosaic pathad a i thelthad an JPG erui podannen, an i chest anna erin hain chenatha egor faeg i thand randir apa.
• I randir cenannen anna vo i vosaic dad, apa i genoer ceniannen. Danno cenatha, tirio, egor faeg i venel, sui genor benn i vosaic.
• I chest hen cenatha i genor erui, ú-erin i harn i chenor egor tolthad i thand dínen.
• Ir i chenor dínen ú-erin cenatha ben unin luith erui, i chenatha erin ben paned erui: ir i host chenatha panno egor chenatha ceria vi paned, i chîn "Ceno" dâd ú-erin vi paned hen tenna i chest bo.
help.straighten_content:
Tad thail an trenarna randir gwathui, gwestannen na i vagol eiconau (dago daerageb ben i eicon 'Trenarna' an gweth dangwethad), i lend Randirain, egor dago daerageb ben i chair:
• Trenarn dad-benn: latha bân dad-benn ias tegitha lath eglerol ben ass i pân ortheri egor pendrad vi i randir; i chair dangwethad hain ithil auto ah cened ben i randir, si lain an athrenna i lath.
• Trenarn auto-hired: cened i chair sen erui (ú-thegitha), a trenarna bân i randir/randirain gwestannen; i chegin cuil iannen ben i gwethad hain linnannen gwen. Man i lû ah pân randirain hâd. Er fenestra crist tiro i nifred randirain trenarnannen vaeth a i lend re ú-cenir chair veleg.
